_comment: #476 — the trading-day boundary, proven end to end against a REAL feed. Start it a few minutes before the anchor you set in user_configs/market_config.json::market_rules.crypto.trading_day_anchor and watch the session log rotate. It reads live Kraken ticks and takes live decisions, but dry_run is pinned true HERE so no order reaches the venue: a profile may only TIGHTEN the broker's posture, never loosen it, and on this machine the kraken_spot default is live.
name: kraken_spot_ethusd_day_boundary

deployment._comment: true on purpose — the boundary is a property of a running deployment, and a one-off would not be the thing under test.

tick_source._comment: ETHUSD rather than DOTUSD because the tick path has to be exercised too: the rotation fires on the heartbeat within half a second, and a dense feed is what proves the tick-side branch as well.
